chunks: Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated from Husayn ibn Usamah who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say: 'You will not be a believer until you are fearful and hopeful, until you are an actor for what you fear and hope for.'
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for being a true believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kitab al-Zuhd*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes that true *iman* is not merely cognitive but requires the dynamic interplay of *khawf* (fear of divine retribution) and *rajāʾ* (hope for mercy), which must culminate in practical action. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the unity of belief and deed, where internal spiritual states are validated by their manifestation in worship and good conduct, preventing the stagnation of mere theoretical faith.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 28.Muḥammad ibn Sinān narrated from Ḥusayn ibn Usāmah who said, “
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (a) say, ‘You will not be a [true] believer until you have fear and hope, and until you act upon what you fear and hope for.’”
